# Pixel Quest

A fast arcade platformer where every level fights back. Chase the high score and beat your friends.

![Gameplay](assets/screenshot-gameplay.png)

## Features

- Fast, fair gameplay - easy to learn, hard to put down
- 40 handcrafted levels with boss fights
- Local multiplayer: share the couch and the leaderboard
- Power-ups and surprises in every run

## Install

`npm install && npm start`
